turns.question: From Wakefield Cathedral to Yorkshire Sculpture Park tomorrow, by bus
turns.reply:
The 96 bus runs between Wakefield and Barnsley with regular stops at Yorkshire Sculpture Park.
 Tomorrow is Monday, so you'll need to get from Wakefield Cathedral to Wakefield city centre first, then pick up the 96 from there.

From the Cathedral, 
the city-centre bus station is about a 5-minute walk away, and 
the Free City Bus also has stops within close proximity of the cathedral.
 The Free City Bus connects to various city-centre stops and is free to use, which could be a useful way to reach the main bus station if you prefer not to walk.

Once you're at Wakefield Bus Station (WF1 3AQ), you can catch the 96 direct to Yorkshire Sculpture Park. 
The 96 runs between Wakefield and Yorkshire Sculpture Park with half-hourly frequency on weekdays, so there should be regular buses throughout the day.

For exact departure times tomorrow, use the West Yorkshire Metro journey planner at planner.wymetro.com, that'll give you live timetables and allow you to see the specific buses and their times for Monday. You can also check live bus times on yournextbus.co.uk for real-time information on the day itself.
